$comment: EVERY BOX ON THE SITE. Add an entry here (and the product in Shopify) and the box gets its page, its menu links and its builder. No theme change.
page_template     the page template the build creates for this box. In Shopify: Online Store > Pages > (the page) > Theme template.
page_url          that page's address, e.g. /pages/trio. The menus link here.
banner            the banner at the top of the box page: heading, subheading, image_desktop, image_mobile.
builder_heading   the title above the builder.
box_name          the name in the builder's messages ("Add 3 items to complete your ...").
product_handle    the Shopify product that is sold (its URL handle). Sizes, prices and stock come from Shopify.
perfumes_per_box  how many perfumes the shopper picks.
perfume_collection_per_size   per size (the product's variant name, e.g. "50ml"), the collection the perfumes come from.
perfume_collection            instead of the above: one collection for every size.
standard_price_per_size       optional. The struck-through price, until the product has a compare-at price in Shopify.
menu              optional. Leave it out and the box is in no menu. It has label, image, image_alt, and shown_in:
where in the HEADER MENU (at the top of every page) the box is listed. Any of:
"shop_menu_more_ways_to_shop"   SHOP menu > "More ways to shop"   (desktop dropdown and mobile menu)
"shop_menu_bundles"             SHOP menu > "Bundles"             (desktop dropdown and mobile menu)
"bundles_menu"                  the BUNDLES menu                  (desktop dropdown and mobile menu)
"mobile_menu_own_link"          its own link in the mobile menu, like DISCOVERY BOX
(on desktop, top-level links are set in Shopify: Online Store > Navigation)
Menus list the boxes in the order they are in this file.
